data_fields.name: poison_tick
data_fields.donor_constant: 8 HP per owner turn (default; WML override)

data_fields.name: rest_heal
data_fields.donor_constant: 2 HP per owner turn when resting or healthy (default)

data_fields.name: poison_hp_floor
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 HP (tick cannot take a unit below 1)

data_fields.name: heal_stacking_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: non-cumulative heal sources take the maximum; cumulative values sum

best_idea: A damage-over-time that cannot kill: it ticks only on the victim's own turn, stops at 1 HP, a three-step cure ladder (tick, slow, cure) decides whether it ticks, and non-cumulative heals take the single best source instead of a sum.
decision_why: Keep the cure ladder, the 1-HP floor and the best-single-heal rule; move the tick to a fixed engine cadence (no turn in a fast duel) and make a cure turn heal (donor skips the heal, D1); reject the turn-start coupling.
acceptance: A server test asserts a poison tick never takes a target below 1 HP, a cure clears poison and applies the village or healer heal the same turn, and two non-cumulative heal sources give the better single value, not the sum.
